## 更新内容

### 主界面

- 重构播放区样式：封面加大圆角与细描边，歌名和专辑信息字号加大，歌词来源改为胶囊标签，播放/暂停改为圆形主按钮。
- 播放队列统一分组标题，曲目数和当前曲目卡片样式更清晰，列表项支持圆角悬停；空队列和无歌词时显示图标与提示。
- 队列/歌词切换器改为胶囊样式，选中项由滑动指示条标出。
- 新增界面动效：按钮悬停放大、按下回弹；切歌时封面、歌名和当前曲目依次进入；切换队列与歌词、进出设置页和引导页均有过渡。动效跟随 Windows“动画效果”设置，关闭后不再播放。
- 设置页统一卡片圆角、分组标题和间距，开关显示本地化的“开/关”。
- 润色中英文界面说明文案。

### 任务栏

- 切歌、歌词出现或消失时沿用歌词的滑入转场；封面切换改为交叉淡化。
- 暂停时文字和封面变淡，不悬停也能看出播放状态。
- 长歌词滚动时两侧边缘渐隐，开头停顿时首字保持清晰。
- 系统明暗未变化时不再重复应用主题，减少周期性重绘。

### 修复

- 系统为深色、Lyrider 设为浅色时，主界面次要文字（歌手、时长、进度时间等）显示为白色几乎不可见。
- 未打包运行时设置页开关显示英文 On/Off。
- 随机播放、上一首、播放/暂停、下一首及队列/歌词切换等图标按钮缺少无障碍名称，读屏软件无法朗读。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.5.0.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.5.0.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。

## 验证

- x64 构建：零错误。
- 逻辑及服务测试：320/320 通过。
- 任务栏封面集成测试：6/6 通过。
- 桌面歌词与任务栏 WPF 测试：51/52 通过。未通过的桌面歌词右键菜单测试在本次任务栏改动之前的代码上同样超时，与本次改动无关。
- 实机确认深色/浅色主界面、队列与歌词切换动效、按钮无障碍名称及任务栏暂停变淡；任务栏切歌滑入、封面淡化和跑马灯渐隐未在实机截图确认。
- `git diff --check` 通过。

相关 Pull Request：[#23 主界面样式、动效与文案](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/23)、[#24 任务栏转场与暂停状态](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/24)。

完整变更：[v1.4.0...v1.5.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0)

## Changes in English

### Main window

- Refreshes the player: larger rounded artwork with a subtle outline, larger title and album text, a pill-shaped lyrics source label, and a circular play/pause button.
- The queue gets consistent section headings, a clearer track count and now-playing card, rounded hover states, and icon-based empty states for the queue and lyrics.
- The queue/lyrics switcher becomes a pill with a sliding selection indicator.
- Adds motion: buttons grow on hover and spring back when pressed; artwork, title, and the now-playing card animate in on track changes; switching between queue and lyrics, settings, and onboarding all transition smoothly. Motion follows the Windows "Animation effects" setting.
- Settings use consistent card corners, headings, and spacing, and toggles show localized On/Off labels.
- Polishes descriptions in both interface languages.

### Taskbar

- Track changes and lyrics appearing or disappearing reuse the lyric slide transition; artwork changes crossfade.
- Text and artwork dim while paused, so the state is visible without hovering.
- Long scrolling lyrics fade at the edges, keeping the first characters crisp during the initial pause.
- The theme is reapplied only when the system light/dark mode changes, reducing periodic redraws.

### Fixes

- Secondary text in the main window (artist, durations, playback time) was nearly invisible in light mode when Windows used dark mode.
- Settings toggles showed English On/Off when running unpackaged.
- Icon-only buttons (shuffle, previous, play/pause, next, queue/lyrics) had no accessible names for screen readers.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.5.0.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly.

The x64 build passed with no errors; all 320 logic/service tests and 6 taskbar artwork integration tests passed. 51 of 52 WPF tests passed; the desktop-lyrics context-menu test also times out on code without these changes. Light/dark main window, queue and lyrics transitions, accessible names, and taskbar dimming were checked on a running app; taskbar track transitions, artwork crossfade, and marquee edge fades were not captured on a live taskbar. `git diff --check` passed.

Full changelog: [v1.4.0...v1.5.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0)
